column1: # The layout's visual targets come from the reference font (Chiron Hei HK): how big each part
# is and where it sits are measured (model/reference.tsv, `make reference`) and inferred for
# every component (model/inferred.tsv, `make infer`). A value here overrides the inferred one
# for that component, value by value; leave it '-' to follow the reference.
# (The sizes, insets and positions this file used to hold were guesses after the paper of
# Lai, Yeung & Pong; the reference makes most parts larger: 亻 4.3 not 3, bottoms 7 not 5.)
# Split parts always end up odd-sized (3,5,7,9,11,13), with a 1px gap between them: in a
# 15px box a ⿰ split is one of 3|11, 5|9, 7|7, 9|5, 11|3. A size set here also exempts the
# part from the crowding test (it is legible by declaration).
#   left     width as the left part of ⿰ (first part of ⿲), px of a 15px-wide box
#   right    width as the right part of ⿰ (last part of ⿲)
#   top      height as the top part of ⿱ (first part of ⿳), px of a 15px-tall box
#   bottom   height as the bottom part of ⿱ (last part of ⿳)
#            A number sets the size; '>=N' sets only the least size, and the reference decides
#            above it (川 >=7 on the right: 训 stays 5|9, 釧 goes 7|7 rather than 9|5).
#   frame    inner-box insets as a surround frame at 15x15: <op>left,top,right,bottom
#            several may be given, separated by spaces. 'roof': a roof over the part below it,
#            with legs at the sides and room between them (宀 冖): the part below reaches up
#            under it wherever the reference has it reach half a pixel or more (elsewhere 1px)
#   levels   shape of the component as rows,columns of parallel stroke levels, for
#            components whose IDS does not reveal it (atoms such as 幺 or 灬). This is
#            structure, not appearance, so it is set here rather than inferred: it says how
#            many 1px strokes a component needs at 15px, which a font drawn at high
#            resolution does not tell. Rows are stacked horizontal elements, columns
#            side-by-side vertical ones; dots and slants count half. Its minimum size is
#            (2*columns-1) x (2*rows-1) px, at least 3x3. Components with an IDS are measured
#   place    preferred position within its box in a given context, used by the evenness
#            pass for parts the reference does not measure in their character:
#            The fractions place the centre of the component's ink within its box
#            (0 = left/top edge, 1 = right/bottom edge); give x, y or both.
#            Contexts: left right middle (in ⿰⿲), top bottom middle (in ⿱⿳),
#            inner (inside a surround), whole (a standalone slot), any.
# Run `python3 juxing.py show <chars>` to see the effect of a change.
# --- roofs: the part below may reach up between the legs -----------------------------------
